ItemID: NA; Title: Babel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Folk-pop is less appealing than the blues and classic rock I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Bootleg Series, Volume 10: Another Self Portrait (1969-1971); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Dylan interests me, but I would save this archival collection for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Coda; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock connection appeals, but outtakes are not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Weird Scenes Inside the Gold Mine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Doors fit my classic-rock interests, but I am not choosing a compilation this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Slipstream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for Bonnie Raitt's blues guitar and soulful vocals, which fit my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ride Out; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Bob Seger's rootsy rock sounds appealing, but I would leave it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Boys & Girls; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues and soul sound interests me, but Slipstream is my stronger choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blurred Lines       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Dance-oriented pop and R&B do not fit my current blues-rock mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: It's the Girls!; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of girl-group covers is outside what I am seeking right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lumineers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Acoustic folk-pop is less compelling to me today than guitar-led blues and roots rock.
